editorial:
Imagine getting arrested for a small mistake and never coming home. That is the heartbreaking reality at the center of this Italian drama. You follow Stefano Cucchi, a young man picked up by police for a minor drug charge. What starts as a routine arrest quickly turns into a nightmare as he is beaten and left to suffer in custody. The film puts you beside his family as they watch him fade away, confused and desperate for answers. The tone is heavy and emotional, but it never feels fake. You feel the panic of a family that cannot reach their loved one in time.

The acting is the real standout here. Alessandro Borghi gives a raw performance that makes you feel every moment of Stefano's pain. The pacing is slow and deliberate, which works for the story but may test your patience if you prefer fast action. Some scenes are hard to sit through. Still, if you care about true stories and justice, this one stays with you.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Stefano is found dead in his hospital bed after days of being denied proper care. The official story claims he fell and refused treatment, but the truth slowly comes out: he was beaten by police during his arrest and left to suffer. His family, especially his sister, refuses to accept the lies and pushes for answers. The film closes with text revealing that the real case dragged on for years, showing how hard it is to get justice.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves true stories and emotional dramas.
